A propagation scheme using radial grids (topologically equivalent to rectilinear grids but cyclic in two angular dimensions) for local point lights, allowing approximate treatment of space as locally Euclidean.
It extends the Principal-Ordinates Propagation (POP) method to local light sources by using spherical grids aligned with the initial principal directions of the point source.
*   **When to use:** Real-time volume visualization where lighting changes (TF, light position) occur frequently, and precomputation is not feasible.
*   **When not to use:** When hard shadows are required, or when the volume is extremely large and GPU memory is insufficient.
